name: murasaki
description: Studio theme for agencies and advisory firms. Oversized type, hairline index rows, numbered sections and one vermilion accent.

color_mode.title: Colour mode
color_mode.description: What a first-time visitor sees. Auto follows the visitor's system. Visitors can still switch with the header toggle.

footer_wordmark.title: Footer wordmark
footer_wordmark.description: Show the site name as a giant wordmark in the footer.

section_numbers.title: Section numbers
section_numbers.description: Prefix section eyebrows with a number, like 01 /.

header_cta_label.title: Header button label
header_cta_label.description: Leave empty for no button. A button set in the site menu always wins.

hero_accent.title: Hero accent
hero_accent.description: Colour the last sentence of the home headline in the accent colour.
